summary: Full UX sweep for freezes / dead-clicks / modal trap-outs at 420x800 mobile viewport. All 15 routes load, all 5 bottom-nav items work, every paywall close-path (skip, ESC, backdrop, X, CTA-trial, CTA-lifetime) closes the modal and does not re-open. No freezes or dead clicks found in the requested flows.

issues: Uses native window.confirm() while /achievements uses an inline Cancel/Wipe pair. Functionally fine (cancellation preserves device_id, verified), but inconsistent UX inside an otherwise styled PWA.

critical_code_review_comments: PaywallTrigger.jsx L66: condition `isOnPaywall || isLifetime || isPremium && !isTrial` relies on JS && > || precedence. Equivalent to `(isPremium && !isTrial)` so it's correct, but wrap in parens for readability.

PaywallTrigger.jsx onDismiss is recreated each render and referenced inside the ESC effect — the eslint-disable on the exhaustive-deps is intentional but a useRef around onDismiss would remove the lint suppression.
Settings.jsx reset-device uses window.confirm() — consider replacing with the same inline Cancel/Wipe pattern used in Achievements.jsx for visual consistency on mobile.
Paywall.jsx L19 destructures `premium` from usePremium() but it is only used inside the (already-removed?) banner — verify or drop unused.
seed_data_creation: In-browser localStorage seeded via page.evaluate to force interruption paywall trigger (cot.stats.v1 with cheese.plays>=3, INT_SHOWN_KEY/dismissed cleared). No server-side seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Paywall interruption variant fires only when localStorage cot.stats.v1 has cheese/rice/pan plays >= 3 AND cot.interruption_shown.v1 + cot.paywall_dismissed.v1 are cleared AND user is on trial (not lifetime-premium and not non-premium-with-trial-skip). Auto-trial means default devices ARE trial users, so the modal will fire. Modal testid: paywall-modal-interruption (or -first-launch / -achievement depending on variant). Simulator cheese state machine: ctrl-insert-bread -> ctrl-toast -> ctrl-toasting (timer active) -> ctrl-cheese -> ctrl-grill -> ctrl-grilling -> ctrl-take-out. Settings reset-device uses native window.confirm — needs page.on('dialog') handler in playwright.

paywall_modal_close_paths.skip_button: closes modal, button size 344x44px (>= 40px touch target)
paywall_modal_close_paths.doesnt_immediately_reopen: after dismiss, INT_SHOWN_KEY is set so it does not re-trigger until plays increases again

verified_checks.bottom_nav: All 5 (nav-home, nav-collections, nav-recipes, nav-sim, nav-settings) navigate correctly, 57px tall (mobile touch ok)
verified_checks.page_load_sweep: All 16 paths load with content and zero visible .error elements: /, /recipes, /recipe/cheese-on-toast, /simulator, /simulator/boiled-rice, /simulator/saucepan-heating, /achievements, /premium, /collections, /meal-plan, /grocery-list, /saved, /settings, /privacy, /terms, /asdf-does-not-exist (404 falls back to Home, body length matches Home)
verified_checks.footer_legal_links: footer-privacy-link and footer-terms-link work from any page
verified_checks.browser_back: go_back() returns to previous route correctly
verified_checks.achievements_reset_flow: reset-stats -> reset-cancel preserves cot.stats.v1; reset-stats -> reset-confirm wipes stats to zeros and badge-count drops to 0
verified_checks.settings_magic_link_form: Email input + submit do not freeze the page; dev-mode magic link surface renders
verified_checks.performance: All pages render within ~1.5s of domcontentloaded; no >5s freezes observed
verified_checks.simulator_state_machine_progresses: Cheese sim cycles ctrl-insert-bread -> ctrl-toast -> ctrl-toasting -> ctrl-cheese -> ctrl-grill without freezing; rice and pan show ctrl-start and start cleanly

rca of the issue: Not applicable — original reported freezes appear to have been fixed by the PaywallTrigger.jsx changes (added paywall-skip button, ESC handler, backdrop click, larger close-X). All close-paths now work and page remains interactive after dismissal. No new freezes or dead clicks were reproduced in this iteration.
